conventions.convention: The spatial domain is the unit torus T^d with normalized product Haar measure of total mass one. Coordinates and time are dimensionless, D=1, χ(r)=r(1−r), and the action has prefactor 1/4.
Admissible densities and currents are smooth up to time endpoints, periodic in space, obey ∂tρ+div j=0, and have densities uniformly bounded strictly between zero and one.

The quasi-potential takes the infimum over all finite durations T>0 and smooth connections starting exactly at the homogeneous reference density, preserving its mean, and ending exactly at the target. An empty admissible set has infimum +∞.
Time reversal sends ρ(t,x) to ρ(T−t,x) and j(t,x) to −j(T−t,x). Forward action minus reversed action equals final minus initial free energy.

The bridge lemma assumes Countable Choice and uses Fourier characters exp(2πik·x), coefficients integrated against exp(−2πik·x), and heat multipliers exp(−4π²|k|²s). The connector matches every endpoint derivative of the reversed heat segment.

In the two-site example, the bond swap has rate one; the left creation/removal rates are α and 1−α, and the right rates are β and 1−β, with α,β∈(0,1). Stationarity means expectation of Lg vanishes for every observable g.

load_bearing.statement: For smooth periodic continuity-constrained paths bounded strictly inside (0,1), I_[a,b](ρ,j) := (1/4)∫_a^b∫_T^d |j+∇ρ|²/[ρ(1−ρ)] dx dt.
For the stated smooth periodic interior-valued density/current paths satisfying continuity, I_[0,T](ρ,j)−I_[0,T](ρ^θ,j^θ)=∫f(ρ(T,x))dx−∫f(ρ(0,x))dx, where f(u)=u log u+(1−u)log(1−u).

Assuming Countable Choice, for the stated smooth periodic fixed-mean interior-valued target, its heat profiles converge to the mean in C∞. For every S≥1 there is a smooth unit-duration fixed-mean connector from the homogeneous mean to ρ_S, preserving the stated density bounds, matching all derivatives of the reversed heat segment at its endpoint, and having action tending to zero as S→∞.
V_reference(ρ) is the infimum of the defined action over all finite-duration smooth fixed-mean connections from the homogeneous reference profile to ρ, with infimum of the empty set equal to +∞.
H_reference(ρ)=∫[f(ρ)−f(reference)−(log reference−log(1−reference))(ρ−reference)]dx. At matching mean, this equals ∫f(ρ)dx−f(reference).
